No. Promo codes can't be added after an order is placed, and that applies even inside the 2-hour window. Only one code is allowed per order, and if you're a Leafy Plus member, a code can't be combined with member pricing on the same item (the better discount applies automatically).

- **Separate order for the pot:** A new order can carry its own promo code, since the limit is one per order. I don't know the terms of your specific code, so I can't promise it will apply to a pot. Shipping on that order would be $7.95 unless it comes to $75 or more after discounts.
- **Cancel and reorder:** You could cancel the current order free within the 2-hour window and reorder the plant and pot together with the code. The policy doesn't spell this out, and stock and prices could change, so check the details before cancelling.

I also need to correct something from earlier. I said Leafy Plus members get 10% off pots and accessories, but nothing in the policy I have supports that, so please disregard it.

If you'd like to ask about a discount on the existing order, I can escalate to a Support Lead. I can't promise the outcome, since the policy says codes can't be added after ordering.
